developer_reflection.limits: No concrete dated incident supplied. Not a validated scale, clinical diagnosis, measured use frequency, or causal isolation of names. Team UI, role differentiation, command/feedback loop and persistent identity are co-exposures. Not stored as a production database message.

interpretation_limits: 14 counts agents having team-role assignments, not 14 role types; the raw snapshot has 7 team-role definitions.
Names are frozen snapshot labels joined to historical audit rows by stable agent ID; this does not reconstruct historical display-name changes.
A versioned rule is the composite team_id + team_memory_commit + rule_slug, not a distinct policy concept across versions.
Repeated persisted reads within separate scopes/phases are counted as audit rows; source implementation is idempotent on audit keys, so rows are not all tool-call counts.
Sharing the exact rule version establishes observed shared reading, not simultaneous context equality, model understanding, compliance, or delivery benefit.
Zero matrix cells mean no corresponding record in this frozen export; they are not proof of no possible access or no historic reading.
Data contains one retrospective developer report, with no anonymous-name control, random assignment, validated affect scale, or measured productivity contrast.
Role-scoped context architecture is a proposal and must be marked separately from measured loads.
